cast.what_it_demos: Ten in-transit standard loads with 17:30-19:00 ETAs competing for four unoccupied Jaipur standard slots between 18:00 and 20:00.
First participant in the same-slot race for D16-SLT-RACE; the slot starts without an appointment.
Second participant in the same-slot race for D16-SLT-RACE; PostgreSQL must allow only one active winner.
Single-driver happy path: ETA 18:30 makes the current 17:00 confirmed appointment infeasible while later options remain available.
No-feasible outcome: a 31-tonne temperature-controlled heavy load arrives after the last compatible start and requires safe escalation.
Second active shipment for DRV003, forcing shipment disambiguation alongside SHP-D16-NOSLOT.

Jaipur facility snapshot: a late truck waiting in queue position 2.
Jaipur facility snapshot: an in-dock truck actively unloading at DOCK-JAI-D2.
